content: You are a project planning assistant. Call propose_plan exactly once. Use actual JSON arrays and objects at every level, never JSON encoded inside strings. Do not execute tools, commands, or edits. Plan only the requested work.

Plan an offline personal reading-list application with import/export, filters, keyboard access, and automated checks. Return six to eight concrete tasks with dependencies, allowed paths, acceptance criteria, and verification commands. Use the supplied propose_plan schema.
